verdict.rationale: Canny ties feedback to identified user accounts via its JS SDK, surfaces ARR impact and theme analysis through its MCP/AI features, and pulls in customer context from Gong/Intercom/Slack integrations — all directly supporting prioritization with customer context alongside feedback. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of the customer-context view in the actual UI (e.g., customer profile panels) and API documentation confirming data structure beyond first-party marketing claims.
